title: Numerical vortex resolution for the Gross-Pitaevskii equation in the rapid rotation Thomas-Fermi scaling
summary: In this paper we analyze finite element approximations of ground states of the Gross-Pitaevskii equation in the rapid rotation Thomas-Fermi scaling. In this regime, the healing length and vortex core size are of order $\eps \ll 1$, while the effective confinement potential may degenerate as the angular velocity approaches a critical value. In this setting, we analyze the $\eps$-dependence of the ground states and show that the local flatness of the energy landscape plays a decisive role for numerical resolution.
